hook: Know exactly which cashier rang up which sale - no guessing at shift-close.
target_audience: Shop owners with more than one person working the register across shifts.
problem: No way to tell which staff member rang up which sale when the register comes up short.
solution: Multiple named cashiers can be configured; each sale records which cashier rang it up, and End of Day / Sales History report totals broken down per cashier.
